Sources: Hacker News comments, Hugging Face discussions, issues of mflux, ComfyUI, mlx-video and ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper. **Reddit could not be read**; blogs and developers promoting their own engines are leads only. web.summary: Fastest image model on an M5 Max, good for editing; weak anatomy and spelling in text-to-image.
web.verdict: ~4–5 s/image on M5 Max (mflux); good for editing; weak anatomy and spelling

comments.text: The Klein family is mainly for editing; in text-to-image it brings back the distorted bodies of the SDXL era ([vunderba, 24.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49038190), about the 9B).
The 4B needs retries when exact spelling matters (blog test, lead only: [wiro.ai](https://wiro.ai/blog/flux-2-klein-base-4b-vs-9b-5-prompt-image-test/)).
**M5 Max 128 GB with mflux**: about 0.8–1.0 s per step at q4, about 4–5 s per image ([fxd0h, 03.10.2026](https://github.com/mflux-community/mflux/issues/817)).
Practically the best option on most consumer hardware ([Tenoke, 24.07.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49032727)).
Successor FLUX.3 Klein (gated, licence "other") judged very disappointing compared with Flux 2 Klein ([Thorentis, 16.10.2026](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50125486)).
